def add_movie(self, name, price, start_time, end_time, n):
    start_dt = datetime(1900, 1, 1, *map(int, start_time.split(':')))
    end_dt = datetime(1900, 1, 1, *map(int, end_time.split(':')))
    seats = np.zeros((n, n))
    self.movies.append({'name': name, 'price': price, 'start_time': start_dt, 'end_time': end_dt, 'seats': seats})
